items: A completely redesigned interface: a dashboard with Overview, Courses, Timeline, Planner and Checklist views, built for both desktop and phone
Add courses from a searchable command palette (Ctrl/Cmd + K) with category, semester, status and grade in one step
New Timeline board: one column per semester with ECTS load and weekly hours; drag cards to reschedule
Planner shows next-semester Options A/B and your graduation path, and can add a suggestion to your plan in one click
Your data carries over automatically. The previous interface is still available via "Classic view" in the footer
New Catalog view: browse and filter every module by language, term, difficulty and more
Grade simulator in the Planner shows the final GPA your expected grades lead to
On phones, long-press a course to drag it, or tap it to move it to another semester
Undo and redo now cover every change, and the app keeps working offline once opened
The AEDS Assistant and Sync from StudIP got a fresh look that follows dark mode
New Appearance setting with six colour palettes (Classic, Ocean, Forest, Plum, Sunset, Graphite), each in light and dark
What-if courses now stay when you leave What-if mode and are cleared only with the new 'Clear what-if courses' button (with undo); CSV export and StudIP sync no longer treat them as real courses
Restore automatic backup now lists your earlier versions to choose from, and automatic backups are kept only when your course list actually changes
CSV import understands files saved by Excel with German settings (semicolons, decimal commas)
A damaged backup file or saved entry can no longer break the app; unreadable entries are skipped and reported
Undo from the 'Removed' message now always brings back that course, and the countdown shows how long ago a passed graduation date was
AEDS Assistant answers now show their sources: tap a [1] marker to read the cited passage and open the document, or expand Sources to see every document and page used
New 'Workload by semester' in the Planner shows credits, weekly hours and end-of-term exams per semester, and suggests moving a course when a semester is overloaded
Print or save as PDF now creates a one-page-style progress report (progress ring, requirements, compulsory modules, courses by semester and the suggested schedule) for advising meetings
Cleaner Overview: alerts are grouped in one 'Needs attention' panel, most important first, and new users get a short three-step welcome
Grades are colour-coded everywhere (course list, timeline, charts), and a new chart shows credits and GPA per semester together
Timeline gets a semester strip to jump between terms, a 'today' marker and a one-click way to hide past semesters
Smoother feel: animated progress, soft transitions between views (off when your system asks for reduced motion) and a small celebration when you meet every requirement
The logo and browser tab icon follow your colour palette, phones show more content at the top, and Appearance has a new Compact density option

Better accessibility: higher text contrast for small and secondary text in every palette, dialogs now block the page behind them for keyboard and screen-reader users, and the closed assistant panel can no longer be reached with Tab
Added a 'How it works' button next to Print that opens a modal explaining the tracker, loading real data, backups, and the AEDS Assistant
The 'Open in' default now switches to the upcoming semester about a month before the current one actually ends, instead of waiting for its first day

AEDS Assistant's course-progress context now lets its next-semester recommendations reflect what you've really completed, respects courses you count toward a different category than the catalog's default, and keeps suggesting planned (not-yet-taken) compulsory courses instead of hiding them

Added Load > Sync from StudIP: paste your StuMS achievements page to update grades on existing courses and add missing ones straight from the catalog, matched by module number (no login handling, nothing sent anywhere)
Added an AEDS Assistant chat bubble (bottom-right) that answers programme questions via a separate RAG chatbot; anonymous, and the only feature that talks to an external server
Added a Further modules category, scraped from the Stud.IP 'Further modules' section that was previously skipped
Further modules ECTS now count toward your completed total (the 120 ECTS degree requirement itself is unchanged)
Added a Next semester tab with two alternative course-selection suggestions for the upcoming semester
Graduation checklist now shows clearer status ticks (done / planned but not yet completed / missing) for ECTS categories and compulsory courses
The graduation path simulation no longer schedules the thesis or new courses earlier than what you've already planned
The 'not offered anymore' warning no longer applies to compulsory courses, since they run every semester
Added an anonymous course difficulty rating (1-5) for courses you've passed
Average difficulty and vote count are now shown when adding a course
You can change or remove your own difficulty rating at any time
Ratings are stored transparently in ratings.json in this repository
